ruleset.name: Laravel
ruleset.description: Zynqa PHPCS standard for Laravel and Filament projects: architecture rules only. Formatting is owned by Laravel Pint, which runs alongside this in the review workflow — do not add style sniffs here or the two tools will disagree.

element.value: Use the Request object instead of reading from $_GET directly.
Use the Request object instead of reading from $_POST directly.
Use the Request object instead of reading from $_REQUEST directly.
Use the Request object or config() instead of reading from $_SERVER directly.
Use the session() helper or Session facade instead of accessing $_SESSION directly.
Avoid accessing $GLOBALS directly.
Do not leave dd() debugging calls in committed code.
Do not leave dump() debugging calls in committed code.
Do not leave ray() debugging calls in committed code.
Do not leave var_dump() debugging calls in committed code.
Do not leave print_r() debugging calls in committed code.
Do not execute dynamic PHP code with eval().
Use the Log facade instead of error_log().
Use the Mail facade instead of mail().
Use the Storage facade instead of file_put_contents().
Use the session() helper instead of calling session_start().
Do not mutate PHP runtime configuration from application code.
Do not change script execution limits from application code.
Do not block execution with sleep() in production code.
Avoid utf8_encode(); use framework-safe encoding handling instead.
